review_context: A deterministic UI demo QA recipe was added after repeated manual sequencing of validation evidence, synthetic QA run generation, Rust wrapper checks, and checked fixture promotion.
finding_title: Manual UI fixture QA sequencing can accept stale or partial proof layers.
finding_summary: The UI QA path had several valid commands but no single proof artifact that guaranteed they ran in the right order, with strict validation evidence, scratch fixture Rust evidence, and one final checked fixture write.
observable_context: Validation evidence can be supplied as JSON, so the recipe now verifies canonical step order, pass status, return codes, and clean worktree state before promotion.
Rust wrapper evidence is generated over a scratch promoted fixture set before final synthetic QA generation.
The final checked fixture update remains guarded by --write-fixtures.
The recipe reads final synthetic QA, UI data bundle, and POC QA triage files from disk after generation rather than trusting earlier in-memory objects.
observable_decision_logic: A single recipe report makes the QA/promotion chain replayable and reviewable.
Scratch fixture mutation is acceptable as local generated evidence; checked fixture mutation requires the explicit final write flag.
Rust is used where it already fits: deterministic JSON boundary, manifest, source-hash, and snapshot checks.
Validation evidence freshness is a separate gate from synthetic QA readiness and UI fixture promotion.
solution_path: Add UIDemoQARecipeReport and UIDemoQARecipeStep models with validators for strict gate states.
Add run_ui_demo_qa_recipe orchestration around existing validation, synthetic QA, Rust, and promotion helpers.
Add run-ui-demo-qa-recipe CLI with --write-fixtures and optional --validation-suite-evidence-report.
Add integration test using a clean synthetic validation evidence report and temporary fixture root.
Document the command as the preferred full UI QA recipe.
applies_when: A repo has multiple valid QA commands whose order matters.
A checked UI fixture set is promoted from generated local run artifacts.
Rust wrapper reports are reused as QA evidence for JSON fixture boundaries.
does_not_apply_when: An owner-approved runtime artifact registry already binds validation, synthetic QA, Rust evidence, and UI fixture promotion.
The workflow is a production connector or Lake admission flow.
The validation suite has not been run or a clean validation report is unavailable.
danger_if_misapplied: If the recipe report is treated as production readiness, reviewers may overtrust synthetic QA. If the command accepts stale validation or Rust evidence, checked UI fixtures can drift while still appearing green.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify multi-command QA recipes as first-class workflow assets.
Exception Lake design should distinguish stale proof-layer defects from semantic budget or matter-linking defects.
Other repos with UI fixture promotion should add a similar scratch-fixture evidence pattern before mutating checked demos.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture and local artifact references only.
It records observable evidence, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not skip the clean-worktree validation evidence gate for checked fixture promotion.
Do not let scratch fixture writes become production or canonical writes.
Do not promote local candidate QA labels to Semantic Substrate canon from this repo.
